name: Routing — APIM fronting non-OpenAI (Anthropic, DeepSeek, …)
summary: ApiManagement (AI Gateway v2) connection routing directly to non-OpenAI providers — no custom translation policy required.
description: APIM AI Gateway v2 natively supports multiple model providers. Verified end-to-end against Anthropic Claude and DeepSeek using '{apim-conn}/{deployment}' as the model prefix in a PromptAgentDefinition. The same connection pattern works for other providers exposed through APIM. Skips if AI_GATEWAY_CONNECTION_ANTHROPIC is unset.
notes:
BYOM routing through APIM to Anthropic is a separate path from `routing-modelgateway-non-openai`.

No OpenAI-to-Anthropic translation policy is needed; APIM AI Gateway speaks the provider API natively.
